Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Bauble: Action, 2 blood, Vicissitude
+1 stealth action.
[vic] Put this card on the acting vampire. Search your library
and put a non-unique, non-location equipment card on another minion you
control.
Do not pay the cost to equip. The vampire with this card cannot attempt
actions, block or vote. You may burn this card and the chosen equipment card
during your untap phase or when the vampire with the chosen equipment leaves
the controlled region.

Bima: Ally, Follower of Set, 1 blood
Ghoul with 2 life. 2 strength, 1 bleed.
When this Bima enters play, move a master: Discipline card to
it from your hand or burn this Bima. The Bima may play cards that
require the basic level of that Discipline as a vampire.

Let's say I play a Vicissitude skill card on my Bima. And I also find
some way to give him a third life (say, Putrescent Servitude).

Bima plays Bauble, to give an Assault Rifle to some other minion.

Now, in this unlikely case,
will Bima be restricted from acting/blocking by Bauble's card text?
I would say "no". It says "The vampire with this card...". Parallel
includes the fact that a Rafastio Ghoul with a Rutor's Hand does not
untap from it, because it says "the vampire".

In fact, I would say that if the Bima somehow got up to 3 life again, it
would be able to play a second Bauble!

So, although this is stupid and will never happen, am I correct about
the result?

Josh
See you at Templecon with my killer thn/vic Setite deck!
